high_level_description: Bloodridge raiders massing at the edge of their floating snowy island: hooded ranks with tall Egyptian shields and khopesh, their chief in an antlered ember hood holding a staff with a burning ring, ember lanterns, smoke.

style_description.aesthetics: a lived in war camp seen from a little above, busy with small figures, warm against cold snow
style_description.lighting: warm sunlight from the upper right, short blue shadows falling to the lower left
style_description.art_style: crisp pixel art with clean dark outlines, flat shading in few colours, figures a few pixels tall

compositional_deconstruction.background: a floating island with a flat snowy top and blue ice cliffs, over a white sea of clouds, under a clear blue sky

elements.desc: ranks of hooded raiders in sepia rags with tall Egyptian shields and khopesh
the chief, a faceless ember hood with antlers and ram skulls, holding a staff with a burning ring
ember lanterns on poles and a black obelisk
dark smoke rising into the blue sky
